conventions: All [ESTIMATE] values are A1 judgments, logged in research/assumptions/A1.md; published demonstrated values cite sources. die_density_Gb_per_mm2 = (1/cell_area_um2) * 1e6 bits/mm2 * array_efficiency * layers * bits_per_cell / 1e9 where cell_area is given. wafer_cost_usd for A1-03 is per Gen-8.5 glass sheet.

devices.device: Reference: conventional 1T1C DDR5 16Gb on 1b-class DRAM node (Samsung/SK hynix/Micron)
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] processed 1b DRAM wafer $5-6K; Yole/TechInsights figures paywalled and not read
devices.energy: refresh is ~10-20% of DRAM power at idle [ESTIMATE]
devices.notes: Density 0.436 Gb/mm2 is Kurnal Insights' 1b assumption; CXMT 16Gb DDR5 measured 0.239 Gb/mm2 (66.99 mm2 die) and Micron D1z 0.241. Price anchor (not cost): DRAMeXchange 2026-08-31 DDR5 16Gb avg $53.92 => ~$27/GB (from p1-market log); glut case per A-05 = -60% => ~$10.8/GB. cell_area_um2 is 6F2 at F~14.7nm, illustrative.

devices.device: IGZO (or IWO) 2T0C gain-cell eDRAM macro in BEOL above 130nm logic (SkyWater S130 / Fab 25 class)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: +4-6 masks per IGZO tier (active, gate, contact, S/D metal, via) on top of base logic [ESTIMATE]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 200mm 130nm-class logic processed wafer ~$1,200 (no public quote found; Silicon Analysts gives only a node-agnostic $2.5K-20K direct-foundry range, mostly 300mm; 130nm mask set $500-600K per AnySilicon). Use +/-50%. Plus ~$300 IGZO-tier adder [ESTIMATE].
devices.retention: >400 s (imec IEDM 2020, Lg 45nm, 300mm); >1,000 s (imec IEDM 2021); >100 s at Lg 14nm; 200 s at 95C reported; IWO 2T: 1 s @25C / 0.3 s @85C
devices.endurance: >1e11 cycles (imec IEDM 2021); PBTI lifetime ~1 year at operating conditions vs 5-year target (imec 2021)
devices.read_write_latency_ns: write/read ~10-100 ns [ESTIMATE]; IGZO low mobility limits speed (DATE 2026)
devices.energy: Ioff ~3e-19 A/um (imec 2020) => refresh power near zero; standby dominated by periphery
devices.notes: Embedded macro: $/GB not meaningful; compare $/Mb-of-on-die-memory vs 6T SRAM at 130nm (~2.0-2.5 um2/bit [ESTIMATE, textbook value]) => 2T0C ~4-5x denser per bit and can sit over logic. Cell area 30F2 is an ESTIMATE for a planar two-TFT cell at 130nm design rules; vertical CAA stacking could reach ~4-8F2 but not demonstrated on 200mm. test_pkg=0 because it ships inside the customer's die.

devices.device: Standalone IGZO 2T0C DRAM die, 4 stacked BEOL tiers, on US 200mm 130nm line (commodity DDR4-substitute attempt)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: base CMOS periphery (~25 masks) + ~5 masks per IGZO tier x4 = ~45 masks [ESTIMATE]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 200mm 130nm-class logic processed wafer ~$1,200 (no public quote found; Silicon Analysts gives only a node-agnostic $2.5K-20K direct-foundry range, mostly 300mm; 130nm mask set $500-600K per AnySilicon). Use +/-50%. Plus 4 IGZO tiers ~$1,300 [ESTIMATE].
devices.retention: as A1-01 (>400-1,000 s single cell); 4-layer 3D 2T0C with 400 s and 3 bits/cell shown by IMECAS (VLSI 2026)
devices.energy: near-zero refresh; slower, lower-bandwidth than DDR
devices.notes: Sensitivity row below (same tmp_id) shows that only a 300mm ~28nm-class BEOL line makes this approach DRAM-like in $/GB, and no US foundry offers one. test_pkg $6/GB because each low-density die holds few bits (e.g., a 100 mm2 die = ~0.04 GB) [ESTIMATE].

devices.device: SENSITIVITY: same 4-tier IGZO 2T0C on a 300mm ~28nm-class BEOL (hypothetical; no US foundry offers it)
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 300mm 28nm processed logic wafer ~$3,000 + ~$1,200 for 4 IGZO tiers; unverified
devices.notes: Hypothetical sensitivity only: F=28nm, 30F2, 4 tiers. It shows that the line, not the IGZO, sets the economics.

devices.device: IGZO 2T0C memory array on Gen-8.5 display glass (oxide-TFT backplane line)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: 4-6 mask oxide-TFT backplane process [ESTIMATE; standard display practice]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] processed oxide-TFT backplane cost per Gen 8.5 sheet; per SHEET not per wafer; no US line exists
devices.retention: IGZO TFT Ioff very low (SEL CAAC-IGZO <=200 zA) => long retention
devices.read_write_latency_ns: microseconds (TFT mobility ~10 cm2/Vs and um-scale RC) [ESTIMATE]
devices.notes: F=2um display design rule [ESTIMATE]. ~3 GB per sheet. No CMOS periphery on glass => sense amps/IO must be bonded silicon. No US TFT panel fab exists (Foxconn WI never built).

devices.device: OCTRAM: 4F2 DRAM with vertical cylindrical InGaZnO access transistor on a high-aspect-ratio capacitor (Kioxia+Nanya)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: DRAM capacitor-first flow + vertical IGZO transistor module (+~5-10 masks vs 6F2) [ESTIMATE]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] DRAM-class 300mm wafer; needs a DRAM fab (capacitor process)
devices.retention: Ioff <1 aA/cell (Kioxia 2024) => long retention / low refresh; quantitative retention not disclosed
devices.read_write_latency_ns: Ion >15 uA/cell (2024), >30 uA in 2025 stack => DRAM-class [ESTIMATE]
devices.energy: refresh power reduction is the selling point
devices.notes: Cell area = WL pitch 54nm x BL pitch 63nm from 275Mbit demo array (Blocks & Files). Density at 0.55 array efficiency is an ESTIMATE; production node would shrink pitch. Kioxia IEDM 2025: 8-layer horizontally stacked IGZO transistors for future 3D OCTRAM.

devices.device: NEO Semiconductor 3D X-DRAM (1T1C / 3T0C IGZO variants), 3D-NAND-like vertical stack
devices.mask_count_or_adder: 'modified 3D NAND process' per NEO; adds IGZO and capacitor modules [company claim]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 200+-layer 3D-NAND-class 300mm wafer; requires a 3D NAND fab (none in US)
devices.retention: >1 s at 85C (PoC, Apr 2026, company-reported); TCAD >450 s for IGZO variant (2025, simulation)
devices.notes: die_density = NEO's '~10x conventional DRAM' claim applied to 0.436 Gb/mm2 => UNVERIFIED company claim; only single-cell/test-structure PoC exists (fabbed at TSRI Taiwan with NYCU). cell_area left 0 (not disclosed). Layers=230 is illustrative of NEO's 3D NAND analogy [ESTIMATE].

devices.device: HfZrO (HZO) 1T1C FeRAM, serial/parallel 1-16 Mb, on US 200mm 130nm (SkyWater Fab 25 / MN, or Sandia MESA for rad-hard)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: +2-3 masks for FE capacitor module (TI PZT FRAM on 130nm adds 2 masks) [ESTIMATE by analogy]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 200mm 130nm-class logic processed wafer ~$1,200 (no public quote found; Silicon Analysts gives only a node-agnostic $2.5K-20K direct-foundry range, mostly 300mm; 130nm mask set $500-600K per AnySilicon). Use +/-50%. Plus ~$200 FeCAP module [ESTIMATE].
devices.retention: HZO 1Mb 1T1C: 1 month at 85C (Sony/Fraunhofer IEDM 2023) -- far below 10-year spec; PZT F-RAM incumbent >100 years at 85C
devices.energy: low write energy (no charge pump); ~10-20 mA active for serial parts (Infineon rad-hard datasheet values)
devices.notes: cell area: TI's 130nm PZT FRAM cell is 0.54-0.71 um2; HZO assumed similar planar [ESTIMATE]. test_pkg $/GB is huge because a 16Mb part = 0.002 GB; ~$0.30 package+test per unit [ESTIMATE]. Compare to Infineon F-RAM price per Mbit (not sourced; [ESTIMATE] ~$1-4/Mbit at distribution).

devices.device: AlScN ferroelectric diode (Ni/Al0.68Sc0.32N/Pt) crossbar NVM for 500-600C (Penn + AFRL)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: 2-terminal MIM crossbar: ~3-4 masks BEOL over SiC or Si periphery [ESTIMATE]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 200mm BEOL-only crossbar; real cost dominated by high-temp periphery (SiC CMOS) and packaging
devices.retention: stable state switching >60 h at 600C (Nature Electronics 2024); >500C stability (arXiv 2309.04555)
devices.energy: <15 V switching at 600C (compatible with SiC logic)
devices.notes: Density uses arXiv 2504.13283 '>100 Mbit/mm2' scaled-device demonstration with 0.3 array efficiency [ESTIMATE]. $/GB irrelevant: product is kB-Mb of memory for 500C+ environments where no DRAM/flash survives; ceramic high-temp packaging dominates cost (test_pkg is an ESTIMATE placeholder).

devices.device: Micron NVDRAM: 32Gb dual-layer stacked ferroelectric 1T1C (5.7nm FE capacitor), Optane-slot persistent memory
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] DRAM-class 300mm + FE modules; requires a DRAM fab
devices.notes: die density ~0.45 Gb/mm2 is an ESTIMATE (assumed comparable to 1-alpha DRAM); Micron never productized it (no announcement through 2025 per Design & Reuse).

devices.device: FMC DRAM+: DRAM 1T1C with ferroelectric HfO2 capacitor (non-volatile), Gb-class target
devices.mask_count_or_adder: replaces DRAM capacitor dielectric with FE HfO2; adder small [company claim]
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] produced at partner DRAM maker or a future FMC fab (Magdeburg)
devices.endurance: target DRAM-like; HfO2 FE fatigue typically 1e10-1e12 [ESTIMATE]
devices.notes: No FMC chip exists as of 2026 (heise). Density 0.1 Gb/mm2 is an ESTIMATE for a first Gb-class part on a partner's mature DRAM node; FMC says 'Gb or even GB-level'.

devices.device: FeFET (HfO2 gate-stack) 1T embedded NVM in GlobalFoundries 22FDX / 28nm HKMG
devices.mask_count_or_adder: +1-3 masks (FE gate dielectric in HKMG flow) [ESTIMATE]
devices.notes: Embedded NVM, flash replacement, not RAM. Cell area ESTIMATE. FAMES (2026) still calls GF 22FDX FE memory 'upcoming'.

devices.device: SunRise Memory 3D NOR (charge-trap thin-film 'quasi-volatile' VHD) as DRAM substitute
devices.notes: No public silicon density data found; density left 0 -- modeler should treat as UNSUPPORTED for cost.

devices.device: Off-the-shelf Infineon EXCELON 16Mb QSPI F-RAM (PZT, 130nm) used as NV write-cache / battery-free NVSRAM replacement on a module
devices.wafer_cost_basis: [ESTIMATE] 300mm 130nm (TI Dallas line per Cypress PCN) -- irrelevant to module maker who buys parts
devices.retention: >100 years at 85C (Infineon rad-hard family spec); 151 yr class for commercial parts [UNVERIFIED]
devices.read_write_latency_ns: QSPI 108 MHz; zero write delay (no page program)
devices.notes: Founder buys parts at distribution; $/GB of F-RAM ~ $8,000-30,000/GB [ESTIMATE from ~$1-4/Mbit] vs DDR5 ~$27/GB => 300-1000x; F-RAM cannot take DRAM sockets, only battery-backed SRAM sockets.

devices.device: Samsung 10a-class 4F2 VCT DRAM with IGZO channel (demand driver for In/Ga/Zn oxide targets and ALD precursors)
devices.mask_count_or_adder: VCT flow; IGZO channel deposition (sputter or ALD) [REPORTED]
devices.retention: IGZO channel chosen to cut leakage / improve retention [REPORTED]
devices.notes: Density = 0.436 x ~1.4 (Samsung '4F2 boosts density up to ~50%' claim) [ESTIMATE]. Mass production targeted 2028 [REPORTED]. Material card: the venture would sell IGZO sputter targets / In-Ga-Zn ALD precursors, not chips.
